```
public String sortString(String s) {
    char[] chars = s.toCharArray();
    Arrays.sort(chars);
    String result = "";
    for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            result += chars[i];
        } else {
            result += chars[chars.length - 1 - i];
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
    return n > 0 && (n & (n - 1)) == 0;
}
```
